My name is Jocque,  I'm 23 years old, I was born and raised in Los Angeles, CA, and graduated from UCSC with a double major in Film and Game Design. I'm a clean, respectful, and easygoing person who values open communication and shared responsibility. I enjoy climbing and exploring the outdoors whenever I get the chance. I'm 23, I'm from MD but graduated from Berkeley last year and I'm starting a PhD in math at USC this year (hoping to find long-term housing since I'll be here for a few years). Besides studying, I play a few instruments and write music, and go out often to concerts, movies, things like that.

"My name is Luke, I'm 22, I'm from Tracy, California, and I graduated from UCSD with a BS in Business Psychology and a minor in Entrepreneurship & Innovation. I’ve spent most of my life around the world, being a child of a military family. After joining the military, I was stationed in Korea, and Europe for most of my career, so it’s given me the opportunity to see the world and meet all different kinds of people and cultures. You can drop a pin somewhere in Europe and I’ve probably been there. 

If I’m not working I’m spending most of my days, practicing working on my craft, or hiking, even line dancing at a local bar I frequent. I’ve got my associates in Music Production and am currently going to LA FILM for my bachelors in Audio Engineering, with the intentions of eventually getting my masters. I love learning. I also love and enjoy a sense of community. So I’m definitely a people person for sure. 

1-10 cleanliness, I would an 8 only because ever so often I build set pieces and costumes, so in my personal space, you might see bits and pieces of a build happening.
